_comment: src/harness/** is excluded for the same reason tests and fixtures are: it IS a fixture catalogue. Each mount is a deliberately parallel declaration of one component in one state — including adversarial fixtures that repeat a dialog three ways on purpose — and the repetition is what makes the catalogue readable at a glance. De-duplicating it into a factory would hide exactly what a reader comes here to see. It never ships: harness.html is only built when VITE_HARNESS=1.
